description: Find the index of a target in a sorted list by binary search, returning the index when found and -1 when absent. The window is halved each step by comparing the midpoint to the target. Pure and deterministic; every branch is live and reachable (the floor carries no dead code, so a bloated rewrite must add unused helpers, variables, or branches to inflate the dead-code count). The golden arg_sets cover the value-returning domain: target present at the first, middle, and last positions; absent below the range, between two elements, and above the range; the empty list (-1); and a single-element list present and absent.
